meta.originalInput: The most painful kind of loneliness is not being physically alone. It is standing in a room full of people and realizing that none of them actually see you. You laugh at the jokes, nod in the conversations, and match the room's energy. But internally, the emotional distance is expanding. Solitude is peaceful. Disconnection in a crowd is exhausting. Stop trying to shrink the gap with people who never cross it. Authentic connection begins when you stop performing.
